comparison.objective: Refit and lock a car headrest at its lowest position.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually align two long posts, insert them into paired sleeves, and engage a sprung pawl/notch.
comparison.success_condition: Both posts inserted, lowest notch locked, headrest aligned, released, and still; drops or forced pawl bypass fail.
comparison.reason: Paired-post insertion and latch engagement test a different physical ability from screening free media.
